description: Fetch a public URL and render the page to PDF in a headless browser. Use this to archive or print a web page. This tool takes a URL rather than a file, so output_path is required. The input is uploaded to the Papyrio API, processed in memory and not stored. The result is written to output_path, replacing any file already there, and the call returns that path and the size in bytes. Inputs are limited to 50 MB, and each call counts as one operation against the daily quota.

output_path.description: Absolute path to write the .pdf result to. Required for this tool.

url.description: Publicly reachable page URL, including https://.

name: webpage_to_pdf
